contentPattern.structure: background photo + navy box (eyebrow + heading + stacked CTA buttons)

suitableFor: product landing heroes with a background photo and multiple CTAs

implementationNote: Block-based component (block/v1/block) with an editable background image, richtext eyebrow+heading, and repeating hero-cta-button items (label + link + style primary/secondary/ghost). Named hero-cta (not columns-*) so md2jcr keeps the variant class.
